visual_style: Consistent typography and spacing: a strong cover, one idea per slide, a summary or call to action.
rights_requirements: Pictures are approved, owned or AI-drawn; AI pictures are only made for the cover unless the format says otherwise.
render_notes: Slides are 1080x1350 JPEGs (4:5, Instagram's tallest carousel shape) or 1080x1080.
YouTube gets the same slides as a slideshow Short with music.
platform_notes: Instagram carousels hold up to 10 slides.
Each slide should make sense alone and pull to the next.
format: 5-8 swipeable slides: a cover hook, one concept per slide, an example, a summary or call to action
